purpose: Frozen joint five-site data protocol used by every model in the STDE-CDM paper

split.procedure: Select 50 locked TEST days from all 731 days, then select 50 VS days from the remaining 681 days with the same random state

normalization.nwp_statistics: estimated on LS only, independently for each site
normalization.target_scaling: model-specific LS-only scaling for WGAN-GP, VAE, and UMNN; per-unit target used directly by diffusion models
